In CISA KEV: from the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (version 2026.10.13), Microsoft entries only. The catalog has 390 Microsoft entries, 81 of which are in these monthly tables. Its 22 entries here aren't marked Exploited by ZDI. The other KEV entries are outside these releases, mostly older CVEs. Wormable is taken from ZDI's own posts, which named 59 October 2026 CVEs and 4 others (May, June and August 2026). ZDI's September 2026 post says 20 are wormable but doesn't list them, so September is not tagged. Other months are not tagged. Treat the Wormable filter as a floor, not a complete count. 50 CVEs per page, latest release first. PRIORITY marks CVEs that are exploited (ZDI or CISA KEV), wormable (ZDI-named), or Critical and publicly disclosed.

Click a CVE id to open its MSRC advisory. Third-party (*) rows are not included in this dashboard.
